recordings.title: Doomu jiitle du doom.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: BU writes “Doomu jiitle”; the collection’s main text writes “Doomu-jittle”.

recordings.title: Jigéén soppal te bul wóólu.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: The lesson title spells “Jigéén” and “wóólu”; the collection spells “Jigéen” and “wóolu”.

recordings.title: Ku yàgg ci teen, baag fekk la fa.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: The BU transcript title reads “Ku Yàgg Ci Teen”; its webpage heading instead says “Ku gàgg ci teen”. The collection reads “Ku yàgg cib teen”.

recordings.title: Ku topp sa banneex, góób sa naqar.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: This follows the collection’s alternate version “Ku topp sa bànneex, góob sa naqar”, with different accent spelling.

recordings.title: Mag mat naa bàyyi cim rééw.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: The lesson title spells “rééw”; the collection spells “réew”.

recordings.title: Nit, nitay garabam.
recordings.sourceTitle: Boston University African Studies Center — African Proverbs Project
recordings.variantNote: BU joins “nitay”; the collection separates “nit ay”.
